As ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' dates the Starkiller Incident to [[34 ABY]], it can be deduced the events of ''Star Wars'': Episode IX ''The Rise of Skywalker'' take place in [[35 ABY]]. |series= |preceded by=''[[Star Wars: The Last Jedi: Expanded Edition]]'' |followed by= }} '''''Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: Expanded Edition''''' is an adult novelization that adapts the events of the homonymous [[2019]] [[Star Wars: Episode IX The Rise of Skywalker|film]]. The novel was written by [[Rae Carson]], and published on [[March 17]], [[2020]] by [[Del Rey]].
